PACKAGE CONTENTS & INSTALLATION NOTE: Includes 1 x Rear Hub Motor Wheel Assembly with pre-installed 10x2.75-6.5 tubeless tire, 92.7 cm motor cable, and axle mounting nuts and lock washers. (Note: Brake disc rotor is not included.)
